messages:
ashok: Quick question for the group — for the inference gateway, do we expose typed protobuf/gRPC endpoints per model/route, or keep a single JSON REST endpoint and do routing based on a route param? Browsers + console UX matter.
maria: my 2¢: typed gRPC is nicer for SDKs and contract safety. codegen + smaller wire formats. But browser clients need grpc-web + envoy or a json adapter.
sara: single JSON endpoint simplifies client-side but pushes validation/routing logic to gateway. Harder to enforce per-tenant quotas and per-route latency SLAs.
jordan: hybrid approach: internal services talk gRPC; public surface uses HTTP/JSON via Envoy transcoding. That buys typed contracts internally and browser compat outside.
ashok: hybrid sounds good on paper. worry: tool-calling / open-ended model args — protos get messy if we try to model every possible plugin input. We already have features that allow map<string, any> in payloads; protoproto doesn't love 'any'.
maria: agree. one pattern: keep core fields typed in proto (prompt, model, max_tokens) and a single opaque json_blob for extensions. proto example:

```proto
message InferenceRequest {
  string tenant_id = 1;
  string model = 2;
  string prompt = 3;
  map<string, string> meta = 4;
  string extension_json = 5; // opaque, validated by runtime
}
```

That keeps codegen-friendly fields and gives us an escape hatch.
sara: if we do that, we need schema validation at the gateway or runtime? For quotas/routing we only need tenant_id + model. But for per-route field validations (e.g., structured outputs) runtime is better.
jordan: telemetry callout: where do we emit token-level traces? gateway can capture request/response and timings but won't see token generation timing inside the runtime. I'd prefer gateway to emit request/response-level metrics and runtime to emit token/kv-level metrics, then correlate with trace_id.
ashok: rollout UX: the Console should let PMs toggle 'transcoding adapter' per route (on/off), and preview SDKs (gRPC vs REST) for that route. Also a canary flag to route X% of traffic to new proto-shape.
maria: also consider versioning: proto options + field numbers allow safe additive changes, but we need a clear migration plan for removing fields. Console should show model compatibility matrix.
envoy-bot: Deploy: envoy-config v2 applied to inference-gateway (sha: d4c3f2). No downtime expected. :gear:
sara: operational note — if we rely on grpc-web + envoy, we must add health checks for head-of-line stalls. Envoy config complexity increases; need SRE signoff.
jordan: summary: shortlist: (A) gRPC-internal + JSON public via Envoy + opaque extension field; (B) single JSON public/internal with strict gateway validation; (C) full typed public gRPC (hard for browsers). My vote: A.
ashok: vote A as well. next steps: draft proto with extension field, update gateway to emit minimal telemetry, and add Console toggles for adapter + canary %.
maria: I'll put a proto draft in the drive and tag @sara for validation rules. Thanks.
